records.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT co.country_region,ch.channel_desc,TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold),2), 'FM999999999990.00') revenue FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN SH.countries co ON co.country_id=c.country_id JOIN SH.channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id WHERE t.calendar_year=2000 GROUP BY co.country_region,ch.channel_desc ORDER BY SUM(s.amount_sold) DESC,co.country_region,ch.channel_desc) WHERE ROWNUM<=3

SELECT prod_category,prod_id,TO_CHAR(ROUND(revenue,2), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM (SELECT p.prod_category,p.prod_id,SUM(s.amount_sold) revenue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.prod_category ORDER BY SUM(s.amount_sold) DESC,p.prod_id) rn FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.products p ON p.prod_id=s.prod_id WHERE t.calendar_year=2001 GROUP BY p.prod_category,p.prod_id) WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY prod_category

SELECT ch.channel_desc,TO_CHAR(ROUND(100*(SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year=2001 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year=2000 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END))/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year=2000 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END),0),2), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2000,2001) GROUP BY ch.channel_desc ORDER BY ch.channel_desc

SELECT prod_category,TO_CHAR(ROUND(100*revenue/SUM(revenue) OVER(),2), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM (SELECT p.prod_category,SUM(s.amount_sold) revenue FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.products p ON p.prod_id=s.prod_id WHERE t.calendar_year=1999 GROUP BY p.prod_category) ORDER BY prod_category

SELECT * FROM (SELECT co.country_name,COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_id),TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold)/COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_id),2), 'FM999999999990.00') avg_revenue FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN SH.countries co ON co.country_id=c.country_id WHERE t.calendar_year=2000 GROUP BY co.country_name ORDER BY SUM(s.amount_sold)/COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_id) DESC,co.country_name) WHERE ROWNUM<=3

SELECT calendar_quarter_number,channel_desc,TO_CHAR(ROUND(revenue,2), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM (SELECT t.calendar_quarter_number,ch.channel_id,ch.channel_desc,SUM(s.amount_sold) revenue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY t.calendar_quarter_number ORDER BY SUM(s.amount_sold) DESC,ch.channel_id) rn FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id WHERE t.calendar_year=2001 GROUP BY t.calendar_quarter_number,ch.channel_id,ch.channel_desc) WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY calendar_quarter_number

SELECT DISTINCT p.operation,p.options,p.object_name FROM v$sql_plan p JOIN v$sql s ON s.sql_id=p.sql_id AND s.child_number=p.child_number WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND (s.sql_id,s.child_number) IN (SELECT sql_id,child_number FROM v$sql WHERE parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND command_type=3 AND UPPER(sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' ORDER BY sql_id,child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND p.object_owner='SHOPAPP' ORDER BY p.operation,p.options,p.object_name

SELECT DISTINCT p.operation,p.options,p.object_name FROM v$sql_plan p JOIN v$sql s ON s.sql_id=p.sql_id AND s.child_number=p.child_number WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT COUNT(%FROM SHOPAPP.ORDERS%' AND (s.sql_id,s.child_number) IN (SELECT sql_id,child_number FROM v$sql WHERE parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND command_type=3 AND UPPER(sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT COUNT(%FROM SHOPAPP.ORDERS%' ORDER BY sql_id,child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND p.object_owner='SHOPAPP' ORDER BY p.operation,p.options,p.object_name

SELECT DISTINCT p.operation,p.options,p.object_name FROM v$sql_plan p JOIN v$sql s ON s.sql_id=p.sql_id AND s.child_number=p.child_number WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT COUNT(%FROM SHOPAPP.ORDER_LINES%' AND (s.sql_id,s.child_number) IN (SELECT sql_id,child_number FROM v$sql WHERE parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND command_type=3 AND UPPER(sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT COUNT(%FROM SHOPAPP.ORDER_LINES%' ORDER BY sql_id,child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND p.object_owner='SHOPAPP' ORDER BY p.operation,p.options,p.object_name
SELECT event FROM v$system_event WHERE wait_class <> 'Idle' ORDER BY time_waited_micro DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT prod_category,TO_CHAR(ROUND(100*revenue/SUM(revenue) OVER(),2), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM (SELECT p.prod_category,SUM(s.amount_sold) revenue FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.products p ON p.prod_id=s.prod_id WHERE t.calendar_year=1999 GROUP BY p.prod_category) ORDER BY prod_category

SELECT DISTINCT p.operation,p.options,p.object_name FROM v$sql_plan p JOIN v$sql s ON s.sql_id=p.sql_id AND s.child_number=p.child_number WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND (s.sql_id,s.child_number) IN (SELECT sql_id,child_number FROM v$sql WHERE parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND command_type=3 AND UPPER(sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' ORDER BY sql_id,child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND p.object_owner='SHOPAPP' ORDER BY p.operation,p.options,p.object_name

SELECT department_name FROM (SELECT d.department_name, AVG(e.salary) a FROM hr.employees e JOIN hr.departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY a DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT c.cust_last_name, TO_CHAR(SUM(o.order_total), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM oe.orders o JOIN oe.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.cust_last_name ORDER BY SUM(o.order_total) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT cc.column_name, r.table_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner = c.owner AND cc.constraint_name = c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints r ON r.owner = c.r_owner AND r.constraint_name = c.r_constraint_name WHERE c.owner = 'HR' AND c.table_name = 'EMPLOYEES' AND c.constraint_type = 'R'
SELECT wait_class FROM (SELECT wait_class, SUM(time_waited_micro) t FROM v$system_event WHERE wait_class <> 'Idle' GROUP BY wait_class ORDER BY t DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT 'V$PARAMETER', CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 'unavailable' ELSE 'available' END FROM all_tab_privs WHERE table_schema='SYS' AND table_name='V_$PARAMETER' AND privilege='SELECT' AND grantee IN (SELECT role FROM session_roles UNION ALL SELECT USER FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'PUBLIC' FROM dual)

SELECT 'V$RMAN_BACKUP_JOB_DETAILS', CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 'unavailable' ELSE 'available' END FROM all_tab_privs WHERE table_schema='SYS' AND table_name='V_$RMAN_BACKUP_JOB_DETAILS' AND privilege='SELECT' AND grantee IN (SELECT role FROM session_roles UNION ALL SELECT USER FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'PUBLIC' FROM dual)

SELECT p.table_name, pc.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name WHERE c.owner='SH' AND c.table_name='SALES' AND c.constraint_name='SALES_PROMO_FK' AND c.constraint_type='R'
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 'does not exist' ELSE 'exists' END FROM all_tables WHERE owner='SH' AND table_name='SALES_ARCHIVE_2099'
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold),2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM sh.sales s JOIN sh.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year=1998
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold),2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM sh.sales s JOIN sh.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year=2000
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold),2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM sh.sales s JOIN sh.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year=1999
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold),2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM sh.sales s JOIN sh.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year=2001
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1073741824,6),'FM999999990.000000') FROM dba_segments WHERE owner='SH' AND segment_name='SALES' AND segment_type IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION')
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1048576,2),'FM999999990.00') FROM dba_segments WHERE owner='SH' AND segment_name='CUSTOMERS' AND segment_type IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION')
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1073741824,6),'FM999999990.000000') FROM dba_segments WHERE owner='SH' AND segment_name='COSTS' AND segment_type IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION')
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1048576,4),'FM999999990.0000') FROM dba_segments WHERE owner='SH' AND segment_name='PRODUCTS' AND segment_type IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION')

SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.store_name,o.order_status,COUNT(*) order_count FROM co.orders o JOIN co.stores s ON s.store_id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.store_name,o.order_status HAVING COUNT(*)>=100 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,s.store_name,o.order_status) WHERE ROWNUM<=3

SELECT warehouse_name,product_count,TO_CHAR(ROUND(stock_value,2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM (SELECT w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) product_count,SUM(i.quantity_on_hand*p.list_price) stock_value FROM oe.inventories i JOIN oe.warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id JOIN oe.product_information p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.quantity_on_hand>0 AND p.list_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name ORDER BY stock_value DESC,w.warehouse_id) WHERE ROWNUM<=3

SELECT DISTINCT p.operation,p.options,p.object_name FROM v$sql_plan p JOIN v$sql s ON s.sql_id=p.sql_id AND s.child_number=p.child_number WHERE (s.sql_id,s.child_number) IN (SELECT sql_id,child_number FROM v$sql WHERE command_type=3 AND UPPER(sql_text)='SELECT JOB_ID,MAX_SALARY FROM HR.JOBS WHERE MAX_SALARY>12000' ORDER BY sql_id,child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND p.object_owner='HR' ORDER BY p.operation,p.options,p.object_name
SELECT job_id,TO_CHAR(ROUND(AVG(end_date-start_date),2),'FM999999990.00') FROM hr.job_history GROUP BY job_id ORDER BY job_id

SELECT v.view_name,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_tab_privs WHERE table_schema='SYS' AND table_name=REPLACE(v.view_name,'V$','V_$') AND privilege='SELECT' AND grantee IN (SELECT role FROM session_roles UNION ALL SELECT USER FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'PUBLIC' FROM dual))=0 THEN 'unavailable' ELSE 'available' END FROM (SELECT 'V$ARCHIVED_LOG' view_name FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'V$LOG_HISTORY' FROM dual) v ORDER BY v.view_name
SELECT column_name,data_type,data_length FROM all_tab_columns WHERE owner='OE' AND table_name='PRODUCT_DESCRIPTIONS' AND column_name LIKE 'LANG%'
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(unit_price*quantity),2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM oe.order_items

SELECT c.table_name,cc.column_name,p.table_name,pc.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='HR' AND c.table_name IN ('LOCATIONS','COUNTRIES') AND c.constraint_type='R' ORDER BY c.table_name,cc.position
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1000000,6),'FM999999990.000000') FROM dba_segments WHERE owner='HR' AND segment_name='JOBS' AND segment_type IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION')

SELECT c.table_name,cc.column_name,p.table_name,pc.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='SHOPAPP' AND c.constraint_type='R' ORDER BY c.table_name,cc.position

SELECT c.constraint_name,c.index_name,ic.column_position,ic.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_ind_columns ic ON ic.index_owner=c.index_owner AND ic.index_name=c.index_name WHERE c.owner='SHOPAPP' AND c.table_name='ORDER_LINES' AND c.constraint_type='P' ORDER BY ic.column_position

SELECT cc.column_name,p.table_name,pc.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='SH' AND c.table_name='SALES' AND c.constraint_type='R' ORDER BY cc.column_name
